identity.sagadyssey.commoner.description: An ordinary person living by land, craft, or hired labor.
identity.sagadyssey.freeman.description: A villager or craftsperson free to hold property and make contracts.
identity.sagadyssey.burgher.description: A recognized townsperson with established property or guild ties.
identity.sagadyssey.knight.description: A sworn holder of status through military service; armor still comes from equipment slots.
identity.sagadyssey.lord.description: A noble with a manor, household retainers, and local jurisdiction.
identity.sagadyssey.duke.description: A great noble governing broad lands and serving at the realm's highest level.
identity.sagadyssey.king.description: The realm's highest secular ruler; crown and scepter remain separate items.
dialogue.sagadyssey.identity.commoner.gr: Good day. If there is work, speak plainly.
dialogue.sagadyssey.identity.commoner.co: Life has been manageable, though work and provisions both need careful thought.
Understood. I will see to it.
dialogue.sagadyssey.identity.commoner.tr: A fair price, and neither of us cheated.
dialogue.sagadyssey.identity.freeman.gre: Safe travels. What matter brings you here?
dialogue.sagadyssey.identity.freeman.con: I decide for myself what is fit to share, and I stand by what I say.
dialogue.sagadyssey.identity.freeman.com: I gave my word; I will see it done.
dialogue.sagadyssey.identity.freeman.tra: Agreed, at the price we named.
dialogue.sagadyssey.identity.burgher.gre: Welcome. We may discuss the town's business.
dialogue.sagadyssey.identity.burgher.con: There is no shortage of town gossip, but rumor is not the same as a verifiable account.
dialogue.sagadyssey.identity.burgher.com: I will arrange the people and the order of work.
dialogue.sagadyssey.identity.knight.gree: I greet you. Let honor govern our words.
dialogue.sagadyssey.identity.knight.conv: I speak only of what I witnessed and what my duty permits me to disclose.
dialogue.sagadyssey.identity.knight.comm: Upon my honor, it shall be carried out.
dialogue.sagadyssey.identity.knight.trad: A fair exchange, with honor kept on both sides.
dialogue.sagadyssey.identity.lord.greeti: You stand in my hall. Speak your purpose.
dialogue.sagadyssey.identity.lord.conver: The affairs of this holding have their proper order; state your purpose first.
dialogue.sagadyssey.identity.lord.comman: Your counsel is heard. My household will act.
dialogue.sagadyssey.identity.lord.trade: My steward will record this exchange.
dialogue.sagadyssey.identity.duke.greeti: I have set aside a moment. State the matter.
dialogue.sagadyssey.identity.duke.conver: Reports of roads, provisions, and vassals are verified by their proper officers first.
dialogue.sagadyssey.identity.duke.comman: It is approved. Keep order throughout the lands.
dialogue.sagadyssey.identity.duke.trade: Proceed according to charter and custom.
dialogue.sagadyssey.identity.king.greeti: Approach. The peace of the realm permits no neglect.
dialogue.sagadyssey.identity.king.conver: News of the realm is tested against witnesses and records before rumor becomes an order.
dialogue.sagadyssey.identity.king.comman: The Crown has heard your counsel.
dialogue.sagadyssey.identity.king.trade: The royal treasury will honor the exchange.
dialogue.sagadyssey.recruitment.closed: %s cannot be hired for emeralds; fealty, investiture, or a realm event is required.
gui.sagadyssey.reputation.title: Faction Reputation
faction.kingdom.honored: May the Kingdom's light guide your path.
faction.kingdom.cold: I find your recent actions... concerning.
faction.church.honored: Blessed be your path, faithful one.
faction.church.cold: Your deeds stray from the light of the Word.
message.sagadyssey.character.rescued: %1$s was rescued from the brink of death for %2$s emeralds (rescue %3$s).
message.sagadyssey.character.permanent_d: %1$s could not pay the %2$s emerald rescue cost. This character's life is over.
message.sagadyssey.character.new_life: You are now %1$s, a new person unrelated to the identity, rank, and relations of your previous life. Character ID: %2$s
scenario.sagadyssey.peaceful_reign.descr: The crown remains stable and the roads mostly safe, though the frontier still awaits settlement and rule.
scenario.sagadyssey.border_war.descripti: Lords contest the border, trade roads are disrupted, and armed companies move openly.
scenario.sagadyssey.interregnum.descript: The king has just died without an accepted heir; oaths, ambitions, and old debts are being rearranged.
scenario.sagadyssey.failed_harvest.descr: The last harvest failed. Food must still come from real fields and stores while settlements face mounting pressure.
scenario.sagadyssey.free_marches.descrip: No secure sovereign rules here; villages, guilds, clergy, and warlords maintain their own order.
